# Crate graph

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask graph`. Do not edit by hand; run the
     task and commit the result. `cargo xtask graph --check` fails
     when this file and the workspace disagree. -->

Normal dependencies between workspace members, grouped by layer.
Build and dev edges are left out: `cargo xtask check-layers` has its
own rules for those, and drawing every test's reach up a layer would
say nothing about how the compiler is put together.
